title: Provide a way to copy comment/thread link to clipboard
summary: ### Description Would it be possible to have a way of copying thread (comment) permalink to system clipboard? Sometimes I need to refer to specific comments in conversations elsewhere. The workaround now is to open PR URL and find the specific comment. Using GitHub, this is very tedious as their web UI tends to hide comments behind "load more".
